Bill.BriefDescription: Providing a leasehold excise tax exemption for nonprofit folk, ethnic, and traditional arts festivals.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a leasehold excise tax exemption for nonprofitfolk, ethnic, and traditional arts festivals; and adding a new sectionto chapter 82.29A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.29A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: All leasehold interests used by a nonprofit organizationestablished for the sole mission of organizing, sponsoring, orconducting an annual festival or fair dedicated to folk, ethnic, andtraditional arts, including performing arts are exempt from tax underthis chapter. "Organizing, sponsoring, or conducting," for purposes ofthis section, means activities necessary to obtain artists and vendorsfor a festival, archiving of festival performances, sales ofmemorabilia related to the festival or festival performances, andother, related activities, but only if the funds derived by theorganization from these activities are used solely for the support andenhancement of the mission of the organization.
